description: The product's changelog in one read: `page` (whether the public page is live, and its URLs), `rhythm` (the automatic-draft cadence, the UTC weekday it lands on, the exact nextDraftAt timestamp, and autoPublishDays: the review window before automatic publication, null when a person publishes), `notes` (the standing instructions both AI passes read), `pending` (public changes waiting for the next edition), `draft` (the edition under review, with its full entries. This is the part no public URL exposes; generationStatus tells you whether the AI fold is still running), and `published` (compact history rows with permalinks). The published prose itself is already public at page.jsonUrl.
name: get_changelog
title: Get changelog
